text:
Response A is accurate on every detail I checked: the venue and travel options, the hours, the five-priority cap with leads, the prep items, the Tariq dietary deadline of 31 October, the out-of-office arrangement with Ella, and the optional pub at 4:15pm. It is organised for a busy manager who skims. It also keeps the "no need to send in advance" point. It runs to roughly 130 words, so it is at or slightly over the 120-word limit.

Response B is also accurate, but it is far longer, around 200 words, so it clearly breaks the length limit. It reads as a rewritten invitation rather than a summary, and it adds padding such as the travel framing and "I would kindly ask" phrasing that a busy manager doesn't need. It drops the note that prep doesn't need to be sent in advance.

Response A keeps the same key facts at a fraction of the length and is much easier to scan. Its slight overrun is minor compared with B's.

Verdict: A
